parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Default: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 200.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid value:

- **DOMAIN**: domain name
